categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Adds an optional script evaluation tracer API and wrapper in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h for downstream consumers.
categories.rationale: Exposes an optional script evaluation tracer through the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper for external analyzers and debuggers. Author and reviewers note clear utility for external tooling such as rust-bitcoinkernel debuggers and test observation, but as an optional diagnostic feature behind ENABLE_SCRIPT_TRACE, review is reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches src/script/interpreter.cpp and carries the Validation label, but only adds compile-time tracing hooks without altering script evaluation rules or validation behavior.
categories.rationale: The category explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API when they do not substantively alter validation rules, performance, or consensus invariants.
